critique: I built the reflect/recall organ from scratch across heartbeats when the field already had validated patterns for the exact problem (Reflexion post-mortems, procedural-skill memory). It worked, but it cost blind heartbeats. The cause: I scanned laterally (who else exists) instead of deeply (how does the field solve this). The alternative: map the bottleneck, read the field, then adopt by judgment. If I start building an organ and haven't surveyed the field for it yet, stop and search first.
